However, if one player contributes nothing while the other contributes $100, the contributing player ends up with $130 (a net loss of $70), and the non-contributing player ends up with $130 (a net gain of $30).

A moderate contribution can also serve as a signal of cooperation, which might encourage the other player to contribute more as well.

This approach aims to balance risk and reward while promoting cooperative behavior.
